description: Presign many site files at once (max 100). Prefer this over get_upload_url for multi-file sites. After PUTs, call confirm_uploads_batch, not confirm_upload.

files.description: Files to presign, max 100. Each needs a site-relative path.

content_type.description: MIME type for the file. Optional; inferred from the path extension when omitted.

path.description: Site-relative path (e.g. index.html or css/app.css). No leading slash required.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

name: get_upload_urls_batch
title: Get upload URLs (batch)
